Fixed at the SOURCE by renaming the variable to `section_id`, zero semantic change, rather than weakening the rule. The embargo pattern is UNCHANGED. Probe-verified: documents containing the embargoed acronym in uppercase, and documents containing the other framework acronyms, each still produce an EMB-001 finding. Note also that the repository already carried a documented false-positive registry (reconciliation/reference-embargo-allowlist.yaml) seeded with seven section-id variable-name entries under the embargo-strip carrier CR's section 3; the remainder of the 23 findings were not covered by that registry.

(a) STALE REQUIREMENT (8,431 ES-002): the registry demanded a nested `lifecycle:` block and a `provenance:` block; NEITHER EXISTS in any canonical schema (verified absent from all 5 schemas' properties and required lists), and all 3,724 canonical records carry the flat `lifecycle_status`. The registry predated EXT-10's canonicalisation. Reconciled each profile to its canonical schema's own required fields plus the siblings the live population carries on 100% of records; lifecycle_state_field moved from lifecycle.status to lifecycle_status. provenance is NOT demanded (EXT-15/16 provenance is a tracked backfill under DFR-001/002/003; demanding it here would manufacture a second gate for the same work). (b) WRONG-POPULATION SCAN (158 ES-001): all 158 were research/l3-candidate-universe.yaml deposits and 1 was documentation/manifest.yaml (a CR-BP-94-EXT-01 documentation index whose header states it deliberately mirrors its parent BP's identity). research/, documentation/, discovery/, reports/ and templates/ added to the walk's skip set; the artefacts stay on disk untouched. (c) STALE VOCABULARY (151 ES-003): `serves` was missing from the canonical_types whitelist although 150 live relationship entries across 141 records use it to target the `ecf:` namespace. Added `serves` with a NEW target_id_prefixes constraint mechanism (the population carries the namespace in the target id and declares no identity_scope field). PLUS 1 REAL DATA DEFECT FIXED: processes:process-pr-operate-bbe384's `realizes` relationship targeted a business capability without the mandated identity_scope declaration (required by schemas/entities/_template.yaml and reconciliation/cross-catalog-resolution.yaml rule IS-006/RS-004). Added identity_scope: dea-catalog-business-capabilities. OVER-NARROWING VERIFIED: 8 probe cases confirm ES-002 still fires on a Task missing canonical required fields (11 findings) and on an empty envelope (13), and accepts a fully conformant Task (0); ES-003 still fires on the forbidden type 'part-of', on a non-canonical type, on a serves target outside the ecf: namespace, and on a serves emitted by the wrong source type; and accepts a correct serves (Process -> ecf:).
